violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked green beans (125 F) in the Henny Penny two-door upright HH box (4) for 2.5 hours. Thermometer of the unit read 185 F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: FOOD EMPLOYEE REHEATED THE GREEN BEANS TO 165 F.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. The hot water at the 3comp sink is at 103 F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC WILL CALL TECHNICIAN FOR SERVICE. ENSURE THE HOT WATER REACHES AT LEAST 110 F BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION ON NOVEMBER 9TH, 2026.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: interior of equipment, gaskets, encrusted debris on the exterior of sheet pans, and shelving throughout the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. ENSURE NON- FOOD CONTACT SURFACES ARE CLEANED BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floors underneath the equipment throughout the kitchen are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. ENSURE FLOORS ARE CLEANED BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
